cv.extracted_text: Backend developer, 5 years of experience. Self-reported CV claims 'proficient in Kubernetes, C++ and LangGraph', but the recruiter's reference check with the previous manager contradicts this: the manager states the candidate 'never actually deployed anything with Kubernetes, wrote C++ only as a student, and has no real LangGraph experience beyond a tutorial'. Interview notes are similarly mixed: one interviewer rated the candidate 'strong hire', another rated 'weak, inconsistent answers on distributed systems fundamentals'. No experience in scientific/industrial instrumentation. Recruiter's own summary: 'genuinely unclear whether this candidate meets the desired skills or is overselling their CV, recommend a second opinion'.

experience.description: Internal tools in Python, PostgreSQL and Docker for inventory management.
Rotated across frontend, backend and light infra tasks; some exposure to Kubernetes via a short course, no hands-on production use.
